🎣 Welcome to Ultimate Fishing Race Simulator!
Cast, reel, and discover a world full of rare fish and epic rewards! 🌊

Train your fishing strength, unlock awesome rods, and catch everything from common fish to legendary sea creatures. Sell your catches, upgrade your power, and travel to brand-new islands with even bigger treasures waiting beneath the water!

Don’t just cast — BECOME THE MASTER OF THE OCEAN!

🎮 How to Play

💪 Train to gain Fishing Power.
🎣 Catch fish to earn Cash.
⚓ Unlock better Rods and stronger gear.
🐟 Discover rare and legendary fish.
🌍 Explore new islands and fishing zones.
